name: Kasaoka (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Kasaoka city emblem in white: two facing stylised letters C flanking a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Kasaoka, a city in Okayama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 1952.

features.role: Kasaoka city emblem — two facing stylised letters C flanking a stylised character
